About this item

  • GAMING DESIGN: The GT 30 5G+ features the Cyber Mecha 2.0 design, blending geometric precision with bold style tailored for gamers. The Infinix GT 30 5G+ is a performance-driven gaming smartphone that blends futuristic design with cutting-edge features, including a Cyber Mecha aesthetic and customizable LED lights.
